overview: A rain-lashed tidal port built on black slate pilings and limestone sea-walls. Trade is governed by iron harbor chains, midday tide-gates, brass customs seals, and bitter rivalry between chartered merchant houses.

immutable_facts.statement: Port Vane sits on black slate pilings and tiered limestone sea-walls straddling the mouth of the Ashwater estuary.
immutable_facts.notes: Flood tides rise twelve feet twice daily, submerging the lower pilings and controlling ship draft clearance.

immutable_facts.statement: The iron harbor chain at the Outer Boom is raised at dusk and lowered only at the midday Tide-Gate slack unless an Excise Master presents a counter-signed warrant.
immutable_facts.notes: No deep-draft vessel can legally clear the harbor mouth while the chain is taut.

immutable_facts.statement: Under the Royal Salt Charter of 412, all refined salt and black-seam coal entering Port Vane must carry an unbroken Harbor Excise wax stamp before bonded vaulting.
immutable_facts.notes: Counterfeiting or tampering with an excise stamp carries mandatory seizure and penal hulks.

immutable_facts.statement: Port Vane alchemy is strictly craft-based: pitch, whale-lantern oil, quicklime, and salt-curing brine follow mundane physical limits with no arcane spellcraft.

mutable_world_state.active_epoch: Late Autumn — High Fog & Tightening Excise Audits

factions_control.Harbor Excise Office: Legal customs authority over Pier Seven, the Outer Boom gatehouse, and the midday Tide-Gate.
factions_control.House Merrow: Controls the Outer Wharf, coastal collier fleets, and maintenance leases on the harbor chain winches.
factions_control.House Vesper: Controls the bonded salt vaults along the Limestone Steps and municipal customs credit brokerage.

resource_distribution.lantern_oil: Steady supply in merchant stores; rationed on outer watch piers during prolonged autumn fog.
resource_distribution.bonded_salt: Stockpiled tightly in House Vesper cellars ahead of winter fishing fleets.
resource_distribution.black_seam_coal: In high demand; colliers delayed up-estuary by shallow autumn shoals.

mutable_world_state.global_tensions_index: Elevated — House Merrow and House Vesper are contesting custody of an unscheduled burned coal-barge before midday audit.

factions_and_tensions.name: Harbor Excise Office
factions_and_tensions.agenda: Enforce the Royal Salt Charter, collect port tariffs, and prevent the merchant houses from turning the Outer Boom into private smuggling water.
objectives: Complete an accurate manifest audit on The Redwing before the midday Tide-Gate opens
Keep House Merrow and House Vesper agents off Pier Seven until the Port Reeve signs the seizure writ

tensions.source_of_friction: Suspicion that Merrow winch-crews drop the harbor chain off-ledger on foggy nights
Disputed valuation tariffs on bonded salt-crates routed through Limestone Steps cellars

factions_and_tensions.name: House Merrow
factions_and_tensions.agenda: Protect its coastal collier monopoly and bury any evidence tying Merrow barges to unlicensed estuary runs.
objectives: Recover or burn the half-charred manifest aboard The Redwing before midday
Force the Excise Office to release the barge's timber hull for scrap salvage

tensions.source_of_friction: House Vesper is trying to undercut Merrow shipping insurance and seize unpaid hull liens

factions_and_tensions.name: House Vesper
factions_and_tensions.agenda: Expand control over Port Vane's bonded salt trade and suppress proof of irregular crimson-stamped crates.
objectives: Claim custody of the crimson-stamped salt-crates aboard The Redwing under salvage bond
Quietly verify whether anyone inside Pier Seven recognizes the private crimson die

tensions.source_of_friction: Competes over freight priority at the Tide-Gate and blames Merrow pilots for lost bonded cargo

knows: The Redwing drifted into the Outer Boom chain around three bells before dawn with its wheelhouse burned out.
No crew or lifeboat was found aboard the barge.
Corin Hale is on his final month of probation and needs a clean, documented audit.
does_not_know: Who cut the private crimson wax stamp on the bonded salt-crates.
That Tomas Vesper left his tally post briefly during the night watch.
What cargo actually hides beneath the top layer of salt-crates.
falsely_believes: Believes the barge fire started from a careless galley stove rather than deliberate pitch-rag arson.

knows: House Vesper's private counting house holds an older crimson wax die once used for exempt ducal salt.
The Redwing was carrying cargo bonded in one of her lower river factors' names.
Watch-Clerk Tomas Vesper works the Pier Seven tally shed.
does_not_know: Exactly how much of The Redwing's manifest survived the fire.
Whether Corin Hale has already pocketed loose pages from the barge.
falsely_believes: Believes Inspector Bren can be stalled until afternoon by filing a routine Port Reeve writ.

knows: He signed two blank dock-passes three nights ago to clear a gambling marker at the Lantern Quay.
He recognizes the red hue of his aunt Maren Vesper's private seal wax.
does_not_know: That his signed dock-passes were used to falsify The Redwing's upriver clearance.
What happened to the barge's missing crew.
falsely_believes: Believes his unpaid markers are held by an ordinary dockside bookmaker rather than a Vesper factor.

knows: House Merrow owns the charter hull of The Redwing on paper.
The barge was supposed to unload upriver at Blackmarsh Reach, not drift back down to Port Vane.
does_not_know: That the barge's coal hold actually conceals mislabeled salt-crates.
Where the Redwing's three-man crew went.
falsely_believes: Believes House Vesper hired river wreckers to torch a Merrow collier.

knows: She bought cheap lamp-tallow from a frightened deckhand near the Lantern Quay two evenings ago.
Oil-of-turpentine and pine pitch burn pale blue around damp oak planks, unlike coal smoke.
does_not_know: The name of the vessel that deckhand served on.
That House Merrow and House Vesper are both circling Pier Seven this morning.
falsely_believes: Believes Corin Hale's new Excise posting is mostly dull paper-stamping.

rumors_and_beliefs.claim: The Redwing's crew jumped ship off Blackmarsh Reach after seeing marsh-lights near the sunken lock.
rumors_and_beliefs.believed_by: Night-shift chainmen and Lower Quay ferrymen
rumors_and_beliefs.origin: Tavern gossip along the Lantern Quay before dawn

rumors_and_beliefs.claim: House Vesper and House Merrow are quietly splitting a contraband copper shipment to avoid royal duty.
rumors_and_beliefs.believed_by: Dock porters and rival small-craft captains
rumors_and_beliefs.origin: Loose talk from tally clerks at the Outer Wharf

rumors_and_beliefs.claim: Anyone caught holding an unauthorized crimson wax stamp gets sent straight to the mud-barges at Saltmire.
rumors_and_beliefs.origin: Cautionary warning passed down by senior Excise clerks

unresolved_mysteries.title: The Crimson Wax Stamp & False Salt-Crates
unresolved_mysteries.secret_truth: The crimson wax die belongs to Maren Vesper's private cellar ledger. Beneath the top layer of coarse salt, the crates pack untaxed black-powder barrels bound for a coastal privateer.
unresolved_mysteries.discovery_conditions: Pry open a crimson-stamped salt-crate aboard The Redwing or compare the wax grain with Elena Reed's reagent tests and Vesper ledger seals.

unresolved_mysteries.title: The Vanished Crew of The Redwing
unresolved_mysteries.secret_truth: The barge's skipper and two deckhands were paid off and ferried ashore at Ashwater Bend before hired hands set the wheelhouse alight with pine pitch to destroy the true manifest.
unresolved_mysteries.discovery_conditions: Track down the frightened deckhand who sold lamp-tallow near the Lantern Quay or match the charred mooring rope knots at Pier Seven.

unresolved_mysteries.title: Tomas Vesper's Blank Dock-Passes
unresolved_mysteries.secret_truth: Tomas Vesper unwittingly handed over two stamped Harbor Excise blank passes to pay his gambling debt, and one of those passes cleared The Redwing past the upriver toll-chain.
unresolved_mysteries.discovery_conditions: Reconstruct the missing serial numbers in the Pier Seven counter-ledger or press Tomas Vesper with proof from the Cinder Ledger.
